name: io.github.flow-steward/openviking
title: OpenViking
description: Write, read, retrieve and remove persistent context on your own OpenViking server through its native Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint.

instance_host.description: HTTPS host name of your deployed MCP server, without a scheme or path. Configure TLS and publish the documented /mcp endpoint on this host.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: OpenViking user or admin API key. Enter the complete header value: Bearer <api-key>.
